overview.description: The Clough Select Equity ETF (CBSE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed, concentrated portfolio of US-listed stocks that appear fundamentally undervalued. The fund aims to provide capital appreciation and lower volatility than the broader market. CBSE was launched on Nov 13, 2020 and is issued by Clough.
